summary: To set up for sanity tests: install ansible-core (from source for dev checks), install podman or docker, and place your collection at ~/ansible_collections/<namespace>/<name>.
questions: What do I need installed to run sanity tests on my collection?
Where should my collection live for sanity testing?
How do I run sanity checks from the development ansible-core?

answer_card.title: Set up for sanity tests
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Install ansible-core (provides `ansible-test`). For devel checks, install from source and `source hacking/env-setup` in the same terminal.
2. Install `podman` or `docker`.
3. Put the collection at `~/ansible_collections/<NAMESPACE>/<COLLECTION_NAME>`, for example:
   ```shell
   git clone <COLLECTION_REPO_URL> ~/ansible_collections/community/general
   ```
